description: This PHP source file manages the interface and backend logic for adding blocked devices in a network management web application. It includes HTML, JavaScript, and PHP code to handle user input, form validation, and AJAX requests for blocking devices, with UI elements for setting block times and days.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from the device configuration or data store based on a given key.

methods.name: getInstanceIDs
methods.description: Fetches a list of instance IDs for a specified object in the device data model.

methods.name: getParaValues
methods.description: Retrieves parameter values for specified object instances in the device data model.
